label: nushi_hikou_030_friend_02
text: Looks like we don’t have to worry about any\nmore boulders falling on us now, huh?[VAR 0x0114(0006)]

label: nushi_hikou_030_friend_05
text: There has to be more of that Herba Mystica it\nate in here.[VAR 0x0114(0006)]

label: nushi_hikou_030_friend_06
text: Let’s hurry and find it before the Titan can come\nback for another go at us![VAR 0x0114(0006)]
